text:
leah_pm: Heads-up: final GA gating for Edge-Optimized tomorrow. We still need: contract SLA wording, pricing examples for sales, ops runbook + alert thresholds, docs quickstart, and a monitoring dashboard with live data. Who owns what?

"tom_eng: I can own autoscale & infra validation. Open items: confirm SLO measurement windows (rolling 5m or 1h?) and cold-start mitigation checklist.

"nina_fin: Pricing: sales asked for a simple sample invoice showing Reserved (seat-like monthly commit), Burst (pay-as-you-go), and a blended tier for pilots. I'll draft numbers but need expected qps and avg tokens to model unit economics.

"carmen_docs: I'll write quickstart + migration notes. Need canonical API examples and a small code snippet for node/python. Also want approved SLA text to put in the public docs (not legalese).

"raj_sre: Monitoring/runbook: we need concrete alert levels. Proposal: page oncall when p95 latency > 220ms for 10m OR error rate > 1% for 5m. Also a warning slack alert at 150ms p95. Runbook must include rollback steps and traffic-shed procedure.

"tom_eng: on SLO windows: measure p50/p95 over 5m for realtime alerting, but use 1h and 24h aggregates for monthly SLA calculations. We'll tag samples by request-size bucket (<=1KB, 1-10KB, >10KB).

"nina_fin: for pricing model, send me expected token counts per request and percent of requests that are >1KB. sales supplied a few customers' profiles; i'll synth with 3 usage tiers.

"carmen_docs: draft SLA blurb suggestion: \"Redwood Edge-Optimized aims to maintain p95 latency <= 150ms for <=1KB payloads under normal operating conditions. Customers may be eligible for service credits if monthly uptime or latency commitments are not met.\" Thoughts?

"raj_sre: that's OK. legal may want more precise definitions for \"normal operating conditions\". also add a note on force majeure and scheduled maintenance windows.

"leah_pm: owners: Pricing + sample invoice -> nina_fin (24h), SLA wording + contract stub -> nina_fin + legal (48h), Docs quickstart + SDK snippets -> carmen_docs (48h), Monitoring + runbooks + escalation matrix -> raj_sre (48h), Autoscale policy + infra tests -> tom_eng (48h).

"deploy-bot: Canary status: 3/4 stages passed. Canary traffic at 5% in us-west, no errors.

"tom_eng: risk note: we observed tail latency on long-decode models when batch sizes hit max. mitigation: enable prefix caching and cap batch depth for edge pools. I'll run a targeted soak tonight and post results.

"nina_fin: service credit idea: partial credit for monthly latency breach (e.g., 5% credit if p95 > SLA for > 50% of billing hours). Will propose in draft.

"carmen_docs: cc sales-engineering and solutions on migration note. Also will add a short \"What to expect at GA\" section for customers.

"raj_sre: sample runbook snippet to include in handbook:\n```\n- Alert: p95 latency > 220ms for 10m -> Page oncall (pager: infra-sre)\n- Severity 1: error rate > 1% for 5m -> Incident commander + customer comms\n- If GPU saturation > 90% and queue rising -> Trigger emergency-burst scale and consider rollback to smaller model\n- Postmortem threshold: any S1 incident during GA week\n```\n
"leah_pm: timeline: final sign-off meeting Fri 10:00 PT. Please post links to PRs/drafts in-thread BEFORE noon Fri so we can review.

"tom_eng: granting raj_sre read access to metrics stream now. I'll also upload the autoscale policy to /infra/policies/edge-autoscale.md

"nina_fin: I'll attach sample invoices and a short slide with unit economics by EOD tomorrow.

"carmen_docs: will open PR for docs + quickstart and add the SLA blurb as a named snippet for legal review.

"leah_pm: final GA checklist (short): SLA language approved, Docs PR merged, Runbook in handbook, Dashboards live, Pricing/invoice samples for sales, Oncall rota confirmed. If any item is at risk, flag ASAP.

"incident-bot: Reminder: GA oncall rota needs confirmation. Use /rota confirm-edge-ga by 2026-05-03.

"leah_pm: thanks all. Post updates here only. If you can't hit your owner deadline, ping me directly.
